title: Joint GGT and platelet information for concurrent hsCRP: an incremental prediction test across NHANES cycles
abstract: A log-GGT by log-platelet product yielded source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.000025 and frozen second-cycle gain -0.000697 squared log-hsCRP units (500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.004416,0.001064]) beyond flexible additive routine measures. The registered prediction criterion was not met. This is retrospective cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched external confirmation. Source n=4203, target n=3952; target baseline/augmented MSE 0.743472/0.744169. This tests one prespecified joint feature, not diagnosis of liver disease or replacement of direct hsCRP measurement.
